tables.name: Crime
tables.description: Modified by Leadership, Law Enforcement and Population Wealth. Robbery, confidence games, muggings: acts not typically resulting in loss of life.

results.name: Regular
results.description: The streets are crawling with criminals, and a purse unstowed is almost sure to be snatched. (+4 to urban encounter rolls)

results.name: Common
results.description: Most are used to hearing about trouble every day or two. Everyone knows someone who’s been a victim of crime. (+3 to urban encounter rolls)

results.name: Average
results.description: Theft or mild violence can happen from time to time. Best to keep an eye out. (+2 to urban encounter rolls)

results.name: Uncommon
results.description: Crime does not occur often but, when it does, it is a noteworthy occurrence. (+1 to urban encounter rolls)

results.name: Rare
results.description: Most in the town have had no personal experience of crime in the town, and know few people that have. (+0 to urban encounter rolls)
